notes.title: Smash Cup 1.19.1 is out!
notes.content:
Dear Smash Cup Community,

We're excited to share some updates we’ve been working on to improve your gaming experience. Here's what's new in the latest patch:

[list]
[*]  Enhanced Visuals: We've updated the visuals in menus and during gameplay with new VFX and animations, aiming for a more immersive experience.

[*]     New Smasher Skins: New skins are available for Marina, Serena, Dumbbell, Doku, and Gladys. We hope these add a bit more fun to your game.

[*]     Minimap Added: To help with strategy, we've introduced a minimap. This should provide a better overview of the battlefield.

[*]     Dumbbell’s Signature Ability - Now Empowered: We’ve tweaked Dumbbell’s ability to offer more dynamic gameplay. We’re eager to see how this changes your strategies.

[*]     Doku’s Signature Ability - Invisibility: Doku now has an 'Invisibility' ability, designed to bring new tactical options to your matches.

[*]     Bug Fixes: We’ve made several fixes to improve the in-game camera, network stability, and character movement. Our goal is smoother gameplay.

[*]     Doom Goliath Event: Look out for the Doom Goliath event in your matches for an added challenge. We think it’ll bring an exciting twist to your games.
[/list]

We’re always looking to enhance your experience and appreciate your feedback as we continue to develop Smash Cup. We hope these updates make your gaming sessions more enjoyable.

Warm regards,
The Smash Cup Team

notes.title: Smash Cup 1.18.7 is out!
notes.content:
Hello, Smash Cup Community!

We're excited to share with you some significant updates that have been made to Smash Cup, focusing on enriching your gaming experience. We've rethought and revamped both the Battle Royale and Tower Defense modes, and we're eager for you to see the improvements.

[b]Battle Royale: Welcome to the New Arena[/b]
We've expanded the arena to welcome twice the action—16 players can now compete, up from 8. This new, larger battlefield is designed to amplify the excitement and challenge of each match, offering more opportunities for strategy and combat. Step in and test your mettle against a broader field of opponents.

[b]Tower Defense: A New Dimension of Progress[/b]
We've introduced a progression system in our Tower Defense mode, adding depth and incentive to each battle. As you progress through levels, you'll encounter new challenges and unlock rewards, making every defense a step towards greater achievements.

[b]Daily Tournaments: Showcase Your Skills[/b]
Join the fray in our daily tournaments, designed for 5-8 players, complete with a leaderboard to track the champions. These tournaments are a new way to compete, earn rewards, and make your mark within the Smash Cup community. All are welcome to prove their prowess.

[b]Balancing Changes: A Work in Progress[/b]
We've made significant adjustments to game balance, aiming to create a more fair and enjoyable experience for all. However, we acknowledge that perfecting game balance is an ongoing journey, and we still have a long way to go. Your feedback will be invaluable as we continue to refine and improve.

[b]All Characters Now Accessible via the Free Lane[/b]
We believe that everyone should have access to all characters, so we've moved all characters to the free lane. This change ensures that all players, regardless of their spending capacity, can enjoy the full variety of strategies and gameplay Smash Cup has to offer.

[b]Looking Forward[/b]
This update is a big step forward for us, but it's just one part of our continuous effort to enhance Smash Cup. We're committed to listening to you and evolving the game together.

[b]We Want to Hear From You[/b]
After you've explored the new updates, please let us know your thoughts. Your feedback is crucial for us to understand what works, what doesn't, and where we can improve.

Thank you for your continued support and for being a part of the Smash Cup community. Let's dive into the new and improved Smash Cup together!

[b]List of Additional Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Introducing New Smasher: Dumbell: Bring the power to the arena with our latest character.
[*] Battle-Royal Arena: Experience the thrill in our all-new, action-packed arena.
[*] Tower Defense Arena: Test your strategy with our fresh and challenging arena.
[*] Disco Theme Update: Hit the floor with dazzling lights and moves in our new disco-themed setting.
[*] Park Theme Enhancements: Enjoy the outdoors with our improved and more vibrant park theme.
[*] Animation Overhaul: New and improved animations make for a more lifelike experience.
[*] Speed Increase for Smashers: Feel the rush with faster movements for every smasher.
[*] Tutorial Enhancements: Our updated tutorial makes it easier than ever to jump into the action.
[*] New Camera View Angle: Gain a better perspective of the battlefield with our new camera view, enhancing your strategic play.
[/list]
